_comment: Daily error watch: database errors in the last 24 hours, grouped by type (quoted values, ids and numbers removed, so nothing personal is published). A type seen at least 'minCount' times opens one issue. Limits were set from production on 2026-11-12. Changing a limit or adding a known error needs the CTO's review (CODEOWNERS).
_codeLimits_comment: Code and database out of step is a bug at any count, so these flag from the first one: 42703 missing column, 42883 missing function, 42804 wrong type, 42725 ambiguous operator (all seen on 2026-11-11/12, each a real bug). Higher limits for codes ordinary traffic produces: 42501 permission denied (expired sign-ins, signed-out visitors; about 20 a day), 42P01 missing table (API scanners; the security watch's log scan covers those), 57014 cancelled query.
_ignorePrefixes_comment: Rolled-back tests on production (database function review runbook) end with RAISE EXCEPTION; start their message with one of these so they are never counted.
_known_comment: Accepted error types, each with the register item that explains it and the date it stops being accepted. 'max' is the most a day may show before it is flagged anyway.
